description: This file defines the PageSettings class within the PhpSpreadsheet library for reading and applying page setup styles from ODS spreadsheet files. It handles parsing of style information from XML DOM documents, manages style cross-references, and applies page layout settings to worksheets.

classes.name: PageSettings
classes.description: Class responsible for reading, storing, and applying page layout and style settings from an ODS document to a worksheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageSettings object by parsing style data from a DOMDocument.

methods.name: setDomNameSpaces
methods.description: Sets namespace URIs for 'office', 'style', 'fo', and 'table' from the provided DOMDocument.

methods.name: readPageSettingStyles
methods.description: Extracts page layout styles from the style DOM and stores them internally.

methods.name: readStyleMasterLookup
methods.description: Builds a lookup between style master names and page layout names.

methods.name: readStyleCrossReferences
methods.description: Reads style cross-references from content DOM, mapping style names to page layouts and visibility states.

methods.name: setVisibilityForWorksheet
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a worksheet based on style cross-reference data.

methods.name: setPrintSettingsForWorksheet
methods.description: Applies page settings such as orientation, scale, margins, and centering to a worksheet based on style lookups.
